From: Series: Training Films, ca. 1930 - ca. 1945
Record Group 111: Records of the Office of the Chief Signal Officer, 1860 - 1985
This item was produced or created:1944
Scope & Content: This animated comic film presents side gunner Trigger Joe (voiced by Mel Blanc) as he was trained to calculate approach arcs, speed, and the distance of enemy aircraft. Produced by the First Motion Picture Unit during World War II.
